reviews.title: Works perfectly on Xbox Series X - so much storage now!
reviews.comment: This was a gift to my son who has both an Xbox Series S and Series X. They installed this in their Series X and after answering a single on-screen question, it was ready to go. Gone are the days of loading games off an external hard drive, or swapping out multiple drives to remember which drive had which game. It all fits on this expansion card and they are super happy now. The cost is a bit higher than a typical NVME style external SSD, but the quick resume and plug-and-play nature make it worth the cost. It looks great and is very durable with no cords for the cats to chew on. You can't go wrong with this drive!
reviews.author: Lance Y

reviews.title: Fast, Reliable Expansion with a Fair Price
reviews.comment:
The WD_Black 1TB C50 Storage Expansion Card has been working flawlessly for me. Setup was quick and painless—plug it in and it’s immediately ready to use. Performance has been excellent, with fast load times and smooth gameplay that feels no different from internal storage.
The 1TB capacity is a great size, giving plenty of room for larger games without constantly juggling installs. For the performance and convenience it offers, the price point feels reasonable, especially compared to other expansion options.
reviews.author: Kaab

reviews.title: No More Game Uninstall Roulette – Worth the Investment
reviews.comment:
As someone who constantly juggles game installs on my Xbox Series X, this WD storage expansion has been a lifesaver. After six months of use, I can confidently say it delivers exactly what it promises – seamless extra storage without compromising performance.
- Plug-and-play simplicity – recognized by my Xbox instantly with no setup needed
- Identical performance to the internal SSD – games load just as fast
- Compact design stays flush with the console (no ugly protrusions)
- 1TB capacity lets me keep 10-15 AAA games installed simultaneously
- Reliable heat management – never gets hot even during 8-hour gaming sessions
Considerations:
- The price per GB is steep compared to regular external HDDs (but you're paying for the speed)
- Only works with Xbox Series X|S (can't repurpose it as a general-use drive)
- White version shows dust more than the black console
I primarily use it for:
1) Keeping Call of Duty and other huge games permanently installed
2) Quickly swapping between Game Pass titles without waiting for downloads
3) Storing next-gen optimized games that require SSD speeds
If you're tired of uninstalling games to make space, this is the only storage solution that keeps the full Xbox Series X experience intact. While not cheap, it's eliminated my storage anxiety completely.
reviews.author: Jordan

reviews.title: Great Product
reviews.comment: Great price, works like internal storage, so no need to transfer games like a hard drive. Plugs right into back of Xbox.
reviews.author: Brendin S

reviews.title: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Title: Next-Level Storage for Xbox – Seamless, Fast, and Worth Every Penny!
reviews.comment:
If you're looking to instantly expand your Xbox Series X|S storage without sacrificing speed or performance, look no further than the WD_Black 2TB C50 Expansion Card. This thing is a total game-changer.
Installation was ridiculously simple—plug it into the expansion slot and you're done. No formatting, no extra steps. My Xbox recognized it immediately, and I was able to move and launch games from it in seconds.
The performance is identical to the internal SSD. I’ve played demanding titles like Forza Horizon 5 and Starfield directly from the C50 with zero lag or load time issues. It’s basically like giving your console a second internal drive.
Also, 2TB is a huge upgrade. I used to juggle space constantly—delete one game to install another. Now, I’ve got dozens of AAA titles installed and still have room left over.
Pros:
Plug-and-play simplicity
Blazing fast performance (just like the internal drive)
Compact, sleek design
Officially licensed for Xbox – no compatibility worries
reviews.author: Aditya Maharjan
